name: Jehu (Simeonite)
title: Head of a family in the tribe of Simeon
summary: Jehu son of Joshibia was one of the heads of families in the tribe of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy. The clan expanded its grazing lands during the reign of King Hezekiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Jehu son of Joshibia is listed among the heads of the tribe of Simeon.
